the electroweak radiative corrections to $BR(h^0 \to \ell^+\ell^-\ell'^+\ell'^-)$ are sizable and should be included when interpreting the results of Higgs boson searches.

the electroweak radiative corrections are of similar size as those from the supersymmetric particle spectrum, and thus cannot be neglected in a precise analysis of the MSSM Higgs decaying to four leptons.
